building_advancedores_mine = {
	building_group = bg_advancedores_mining
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/building_icons/building_advancedores_mine.dds"
	city_type = mine
	levels_per_mesh = 50
	required_construction = construction_cost_very_high
	terrain_manipulator = mining
	has_max_level = yes

	unlocking_technologies = {
		quartz_glass
	}

	possible = {
        modifier:state_building_advancedores_mine_max_level_add > 0
		owner = {
			NOT = {
				has_law = law_type:law_polluting_mining_banned
			}
		}
    }

    potential = {
        modifier:state_building_advancedores_mine_max_level_add > 0
    }
	
	production_method_groups = {
		pmg_mining_equipment_building_advancedores_mine
		pmg_explosives_building_advancedores_mine
		pmg_steam_automation_building_advancedores_mine
		pmg_train_automation_building_advancedores_mine
		pmg_data_optimization_primary_sector
	}
	
	ownership_type = self
	
	background = "gfx/interface/icons/building_icons/backgrounds/building_panel_bg_mining.dds"
}

building_aircraft_industry = {
	building_group = bg_heavy_industry
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/building_icons/building_aircraft_space_industry.dds"
	city_type = city
	levels_per_mesh = 50
	
	ai_nationalization_desire = 0.5 # AI generally does not want to privatize military goods industries
	
	unlocking_technologies = {
		zeppelins
	}

	production_method_groups = {		
		pmg_civil_space_aircraft
		pmg_aeroplanes
		#pmg_helicopters
		pmg_automation_building_aircraft_industry
		pmg_data_optimization_heavy_industry
	}
	
	required_construction = construction_cost_very_high

	possible = {
		owner = {
			NOT = { 
				OR = {
					has_law = law_type:law_industry_banned 
					has_law = law_type:law_extraction_economy 
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ownership_type = self

	background = "gfx/interface/icons/building_icons/backgrounds/building_panel_bg_heavy_industry.dds"
}

building_airport = {
	building_group = bg_private_infrastructure	
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/building_icons/airport.dds"
	
	unlocking_technologies = {
		zeppelins
	}

	production_method_groups = {
		pmg_base_building_airport
		pmg_cargo_airport
		#pmg_tourism_airport (WIP)
		pmg_fuel_airport
		pmg_data_optimization_light_industry
	}

	can_build_government = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = mr_airport_can_construct_tt
			NOT = {
				b:building_airport ?= {
					level_after_queued_constructions >= {
						value = 1							# Ensures always 1 level is buildable
						add = {
							state.b:building_urban_center ?= {
								add = level
							}
							divide = 10						# 1 additional level per 10 urban centres
							floor = yes						# Otherwise this rounds UP for all decimals
							# Whatever curtiss flight route variable you would like:
							# add = var:curtiss_local_aviation_enthusiasm
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	
	can_build_private = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = mr_airport_can_construct_tt
			NOT = {
				b:building_airport ?= {
					level_after_queued_constructions >= {
						value = 1							# Ensures always 1 level is buildable
						add = {
							state.b:building_urban_center ?= {
								add = level
							}
							divide = 10						# 1 additional level per 10 urban centres
							floor = yes						# Otherwise this rounds UP for all decimals
							# Whatever curtiss flight route variable you would like:
							# add = var:curtiss_local_aviation_enthusiasm
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	
	should_auto_expand = {
		OR = {
			cash_reserves_ratio >= 0.5
			is_subsidized = yes
		}
		state.market_access > 1.1
	}
	
	required_construction = construction_cost_very_high
	
	ownership_type = self
	
	ai_value = 1000 # Airports are less important than railroads

	background = "gfx/interface/icons/building_icons/backgrounds/building_panel_bg_railways.dds"
}

building_cotton_plantation = {
	building_group = bg_plantations
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/building_icons/cotton_plantation.dds"
	required_construction = construction_cost_low

	unlocking_technologies = {
		enclosure
	}

	city_type = farm
	levels_per_mesh = 50

	production_method_groups = {
		pmg_base_building_cotton_plantation
		pmg_cotton_exploitation
		pmg_train_automation_building_cotton_plantation
		pmg_data_optimization_primary_sector
	}
	ownership_type = self

	background = "gfx/interface/icons/building_icons/backgrounds/building_panel_bg_plantations.dds"

	ai_value = {
		value = 1000

		if = { # British dictates
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_journal_entry = je_british_dictate_plantations
					var:dictate_plantation_type ?= 4
				}
			}

building_hydroelectric_power_plant = {
	building_group = bg_power
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/building_icons/hydroelectric_power_plant.dds"
	levels_per_mesh = 1
	has_max_level = yes

	required_construction = construction_cost_monument


	unlocking_technologies = {
		electrical_generation
	}

	production_method_groups = {
		pmg_base_building_hydroelectric_power_plant
		pmg_automation_building_hydroelectric_power_plant
		pmg_data_optimization_light_industry
	}

	can_build_government = {
		owner = {
			NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_industry_banned } 
		}
		#Actual Triggers
		modifier:state_building_hydroelectric_power_plant_max_level_add > 0
	}

	potential = {
		OR = {
			has_state_trait = state_trait_hydroelectric_water_deposits
			has_state_trait = state_trait_hydroelectric_water_deposits_hidden
		}
	}

	city_type = city

	ai_value = {
		value = 1000

		# Need 1 level of Power Plants everywhere as its a local good and a prerequisite to enabling electricity PMs to begin with
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOR = {
					has_building = building_hydroelectric_power_plant
					any_scope_building = {
						is_building_type = building_hydroelectric_power_plant
						is_under_construction = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = 3000
		}
	}
	
	ownership_type = self

	background = "gfx/interface/icons/building_icons/backgrounds/building_panel_bg_monuments.dds"
}

building_power_bloc_statue = {

	building_group = bg_monuments

	city_type = city

	levels_per_mesh = 1

	expandable = no

	statue = yes

	production_method_groups = {
		pmg_base_building_power_bloc_statue
	}

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/building_icons/building_powerblock_statue.dds"

	required_construction = construction_cost_monument

	can_build_government = {
		always = yes
	}

	can_build_private = {
		always = no
	}

	potential = {
		owner ?= {
			is_in_power_bloc = yes
		}
		has_dlc_feature = power_bloc_features
	}

	ai_value = {
		value = 0

		if = {
			limit = {
				is_incorporated = yes
				state_population >= 500000
			}

			add = {
				value = state_population
				divide = 2500
				max = 5000
			}
		}

		if = {
			limit = { is_capital = yes }
			add = 2500
		}

		owner = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_power_bloc_leader = yes }
				multiply = 2.0
			}

			if = {
				limit = { country_rank < rank_value:major_power }
				multiply = 0.0
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { country_rank < rank_value:great_power }
				multiply = 0.5
			}
		}
	}

	background = "gfx/interface/icons/building_icons/backgrounds/building_panel_bg_monuments.dds"
}

building_power_plant = {
	building_group = bg_power
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/building_icons/power_plant.dds"
	levels_per_mesh = 50

	city_type = city

	unlocking_technologies = {
		electrical_generation
	}

	production_method_groups = {
		pmg_base_building_power_plant
		pmg_automation_building_power_plant
		pmg_refining_building_power_plant
		pmg_data_optimization_light_industry
	}

	required_construction = construction_cost_medium

	ai_value = {
		value = 2000

		# Need 1 level of Power Plants everywhere as its a local good and a prerequisite to enabling electricity PMs to begin with
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOR = {
					has_building = building_power_plant
					any_scope_building = {
						is_building_type = building_power_plant
						is_under_construction = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = 3000
		}

		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					# Leader Producers of Oil and Gas, or rich oil middle east countries will still use traditional power plants more
					NOR = {
						leading_producer_of = g:oil
						leading_producer_of = g:gas
						# Some countries also
						is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_middle_east
						c:VNZ ?= this
						c:RUS ?= this
					}
					OR = {
						AND = {
							has_technology_researched = wind_turbines
							NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_no_protection }
						}
						has_technology_researched = urban_sustainability
					}
				}
			}
			add = -1000
		}
	}

	possible = {
		owner = {
			NOR = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_industry_banned
				has_law = law_type:law_active_restoration
			} 
		}
	}
	
	ownership_type = self

	background = "gfx/interface/icons/building_icons/backgrounds/building_panel_bg_monuments.dds"
}

building_railway = {
	building_group = bg_private_infrastructure
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/building_icons/building_railway.dds"

	ai_nationalization_desire = 0.5 # AI is reluctant to privatize railways since they are likely to need subsidies anyway

	unlocking_technologies = {
		railways
	}

	production_method_groups = {
		pmg_base_building_railway
		pmg_passenger_trains
		pmg_transport_infrastructure_building_railway
		pmg_data_optimization_light_industry
	}

	required_construction = construction_cost_very_high

	ai_value = {
		value = 2000 # Railways are important

		if = { # Trans-Siberian Railway
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_journal_entry = je_trans_siberian_railway
				}
				OR = {
					state_region = s:STATE_MOSCOW
					state_region = s:STATE_YAROSLAVL
					state_region = s:STATE_NIZHNY_NOVGOROD
					state_region = s:STATE_CHUVASHIA
					state_region = s:STATE_KAZAN
					state_region = s:STATE_UFA
					state_region = s:STATE_CHELYABINSK
					state_region = s:STATE_URAL
					state_region = s:STATE_TOBOLSK
					state_region = s:STATE_TOMSK
					state_region = s:STATE_KRASNOYARSK
					state_region = s:STATE_IRKUTSK
					state_region = s:STATE_BURYATIA
					state_region = s:STATE_TRANS_BAIKAL
					state_region = s:STATE_YAKUTSK
					state_region = s:STATE_OKHOTSK
					state_region = s:STATE_AMUR
					state_region = s:STATE_OUTER_MANCHURIA
				}
				NOR = {
					has_building = building_railway
					any_scope_building = {
						is_building_type = building_railway
						is_under_construction = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = 10000
		}
		else_if = { # Shinkansen, my beloved
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_journal_entry = je_meiji_economy
				}
				is_incorporated = yes # Japan proper
				NOR = {
					has_building = building_railway
					any_scope_building = {
						is_building_type = building_railway
						is_under_construction = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = 10000
		}
		else_if = { # Trans-Continental Railways
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_journal_entry = je_trans_continental_railway
				}
				OR = {
					state_region = s:STATE_NEBRASKA
					state_region = s:STATE_WYOMING
					state_region = s:STATE_UTAH
					state_region = s:STATE_NEVADA
					state_region = s:STATE_CALIFORNIA
				}
				NOR = {
					has_building = building_railway
					any_scope_building = {
						is_building_type = building_railway
						is_under_construction = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = 10000
		}
		else_if = { # Canadian Pacific Highway
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_journal_entry = je_canada_pacific_railway
				}
				OR = {
					state_region = s:STATE_QUEBEC
					state_region = s:STATE_BRITISH_COLUMBIA
					state_region = s:STATE_ONTARIO
					state_region = s:STATE_ALBERTA
					state_region = s:STATE_SASKATCHEWAN
					state_region = s:STATE_MANITOBA
				}
				NOR = {
					has_building = building_railway
					any_scope_building = {
						is_building_type = building_railway
						is_under_construction = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = 10000
		}
		else_if = { # AI Metternich wants railways
			limit = {
				owner ?= {
					c:AUS ?= this
					has_journal_entry = je_metternich
				}
				is_incorporated = yes
				NOR = {
					has_building = building_railway
					any_scope_building = {
						is_building_type = building_railway
						is_under_construction = yes
					}
				}
			}
            add = 10000
		}
		else_if = { # Portugal - Regeneration
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_journal_entry = je_portugal_regeneration_public_works
				}
				is_incorporated = yes
				NOR = {
					has_building = building_railway
					any_scope_building = {
						is_building_type = building_railway
						is_under_construction = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}

		if = { # Manchurian Railway
			limit = {
				exists = c:RUS
				c:RUS ?= owner
				OR = {
					region = region_manchuria
				}
				any_scope_building = {
					is_building_type = building_railway
					levels_owned_by_country = {
						target = c:RUS
						value  < 1
					}
				}
			}
			add = 10000
		}
	}

	should_auto_expand = {
		occupancy >= 0.8
		OR = {
			cash_reserves_ratio > 0.5
			is_subsidized = yes
		}
		OR = {
			state = {
				sg:transportation = {
					state_goods_pricier > 0.5
				}
			}
			state = {
				infrastructure_delta <= -20
			}
		}
		NOT = { is_under_construction = yes }

	}
	ownership_type = self

	background = "gfx/interface/icons/building_icons/backgrounds/building_panel_bg_railways.dds"
}

building_rare_earths_mine = {
	building_group = bg_rare_earths_mining
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/building_icons/building_rare_earths_mine.dds"
	city_type = mine
	levels_per_mesh = 50
	required_construction = construction_cost_very_high
	terrain_manipulator = mining
	has_max_level = yes

	unlocking_technologies = {
		rare_earths
	}

	possible = {
        modifier:state_building_rare_earths_mine_max_level_add > 0
		owner = {
			NOT = {
				has_law = law_type:law_polluting_mining_banned
			}
		}
    }

    potential = {
        modifier:state_building_rare_earths_mine_max_level_add > 0
    }
	
	production_method_groups = {
		pmg_mining_equipment_building_rare_earths_mine
		pmg_steam_automation_building_rare_earths_mine
		pmg_train_automation_building_rare_earths_mine
		pmg_data_optimization_primary_sector
	}
	
	ownership_type = self
	
	background = "gfx/interface/icons/building_icons/backgrounds/building_panel_bg_mining.dds"

}

building_renewable_energy_power_plant = {
	building_group = bg_power
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/building_icons/renewable_energy_power_plant.dds"
	levels_per_mesh = 50

	city_type = city
	
	unlocking_technologies = { 
		photovoltaic_effect 
	}

	production_method_groups = {
		pmg_base_building_renewable_energy_power_plant
		pmg_automation_building_renewable_energy_power_plant
		pmg_data_optimization_heavy_industry
	}
	
	required_construction = construction_cost_monument

	ai_value = {
		value = 500 

		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					# Leader Producers of Oil and Gas, or rich oil will still use traditional power plants more
					NOR = {
						leading_producer_of = g:oil
						leading_producer_of = g:gas
						# Some countries also
						is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_middle_east
						c:VNZ ?= this
						c:RUS ?= this
					}
					OR = {
						AND = {
							has_technology_researched = wind_turbines
							NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_no_protection }
						}
						# Late Game ambientalism
						has_technology_researched = urban_sustainability
					}
				}
			}
			add = 500
		}

		# Renewable Energy Plants don't have the "at least one" mechanic as Power Plants already have it
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOR = {
						leading_producer_of = g:oil
						leading_producer_of = g:gas
						# Some countries also
						is_in_geographic_region = geographic_region_middle_east
						c:VNZ ?= this
						c:RUS ?= this
					}
					has_technology_researched = advanced_solar_panels
					NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_no_protection }
				}
			}
			add = 1000
		}
	}

	possible = {
		owner = {
			NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_industry_banned } 
		}
	}
	
	ownership_type = self

	background = "gfx/interface/icons/building_icons/backgrounds/building_panel_bg_monuments.dds"
}

	}
	
	required_construction = construction_cost_very_high

	ai_value = {
		value = 1000 

		# Telecommunications is very important
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = {
					NOR = {
						has_building = building_telecommunications_industry
						any_scope_building = {
							is_building_type = building_telecommunications_industry
							is_under_construction = yes
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = 4000
		}
	}

	possible = {
		owner = {
			NOT = { has_law = law_type:law_industry_banned } 
		}
	}
	
	ownership_type = self

	background = "gfx/interface/icons/building_icons/backgrounds/building_panel_bg_monuments.dds"
}

		if = { # British dictates
			limit = {
				owner = {
					has_journal_entry = je_british_dictate_universities
				}
				OR = {
					state_region = s:STATE_WEST_BENGAL
					state_region = s:STATE_BOMBAY
					state_region = s:STATE_MADRAS
				}
				NOR = {
					has_building = building_university
					any_scope_building = {
						is_building_type = building_university
						level > 3
					}
				}
			}
			add = 2000
		}
	}
}

		pmg_fusion_plasma_monitoring

	can_build_government = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = fusion_reactor_can_construct_tt
			has_modifier = fusion_reactor_site
		}
	}
	possible = {
		owner = {
			NOT = {
				has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_industry_banned
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = building_renewable_energy_requires_national_electric_system_tt
				NOT = {
					has_law_or_variant = law_type:law_no_national_electric_system
				}
			}
		}
	}
	can_build_private = {
		always = no
	}
	background = "gfx/interface/icons/building_icons/backgrounds/building_panel_bg_heavy_industry.dds"
	ai_value = 2500	# AI will rush building this

	building_group = bg_power
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/building_icons/building_power_grid_station.dds"
	levels_per_mesh = 50
	city_type = city
	unlocking_technologies = {

	}
	production_method_groups = {

	possible = {

			}
		}
		# Uncomment as this complex thing makes AI very stupi on PMs optimization
		OR = {
			is_capital = yes
			any_scope_building = {
				OR = {
					is_building_type = building_power_grid_station
					is_building_type = building_power_plant
					is_building_type = building_hydroelectric_power_plant
					is_building_type = building_renewable_energy_power_plant
					is_building_type = building_geothermal_power_plant
				}
			}
			any_neighbouring_state = {
				any_scope_building = {
					OR = {
						is_building_type = building_power_grid_station
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ownership_type = self
	background = "gfx/interface/icons/building_icons/backgrounds/building_panel_bg_monuments.dds"
	should_auto_expand = {
		occupancy >= 0.8
		OR = {
			cash_reserves_ratio > 0.8
			is_subsidized = yes
		}
		AND = {
			state = {
				sg:electricity = {
					state_goods_pricier >= 0.1
				}
			}
			g:global_electricity = {
				market_goods_pricier <= -0.1
			}
		}
	}
	ai_value = {
		value = 1000
		# More valuable in states with significant power generation (upload mode)
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOR = {
					has_building = building_power_grid_station
					any_scope_building = {
						is_building_type = building_power_grid_station
						is_under_construction = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = 4000
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				g:global_electricity = {
					market_goods_pricier <= -0.25
				}
			}
			add = 4000
		}
	}
}

building_computer_assembly_plant = {
	building_group = bg_heavy_industry
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/building_icons/building_computer_assembly_plant.dds"
	city_type = city
	levels_per_mesh = 50
	unlocking_technologies = {
		computer
	}
	production_method_groups = {
		pmg_base_building_computers
		pmg_automation_building_computer_assembly
		pmg_data_optimization_heavy_industry_computer
	}
	ownership_type = self
	background = "gfx/interface/icons/building_icons/backgrounds/building_panel_bg_heavy_industry.dds"
	required_construction = construction_cost_modern
}
